name: serp-bench
description: SERP-Bench evaluates a model's ability to answer user queries by leveraging search-engine-result-page (SERP) style inputs and grounding answers in retrieved snippets. It measures whether models can locate, synthesize, and correctly cite relevant information from SERP-like contexts while avoiding hallucinations. The benchmark focuses on factual accuracy and grounding rather than generative fluency.
reputation: A niche benchmark focused on retrieval-grounded QA with limited but growing use among researchers studying grounding and hallucination.
